policy: Instrument displays show runtime-backed settings and status, the readings the teacher prepared for the lab (decided 2026-09-25, replacing the measurement-neutral rule of plan §2.4 item 1, D7 and handoff G-1), a readout whose provenance is "simulator-generated" where the runtime produces one, and, where no reading exists, the learner's own value labelled "Your entry". Nothing is simulated or invented: a reading is the teacher's value, reached through the steps the learner performed. src/studio3d/adapters/instrumentDisplay.ts implements these policies.

balance-status-and-entry.note: The mass on the pan from the teacher's setup: each vessel's empty mass (a setting, or the approved default) and its solid contents, less the zero taken with the empty support. The precision is the weighing step's input step. The learner's entry shows only where no reading can be known. The id is kept because the models' metadata names it.

photometer-settings-status-and-entry.note: After zeroing on the blank: 100 %T with the blank in the slot, and a sample's teacher-prepared reading (teacherPreparedReading on its read step) in the quantity that step declares. The learner's entry shows only where no reading exists. The id is kept because the models' metadata names it.

oven-setpoint.note: Pack 2 (decided 2026-10-05): the drying oven shows the temperature the student set with its dial, once set; nothing else. The chamber's actual temperature is not simulated.

simulator-readout.note: For instruments whose readout carries provenance "simulator-generated" (the pH meter, in later packs).
